messages:
zoe: Hi finance team - rented a car for field visits, picked prepaid fuel option at checkout. Returned car full, got photos of gauge and mileage. QuickCar still charged a $75 'fuel charge' to my personal card. Uploaded receipt + photos to Ramp: https://ramp.app/receipts/rental-fuel-186543 (images attached). Filing as 'Rental fuel - personal card'.

harper: bummer. can you attach the return photos here? need time stamp and odometer if available. also include the rental agreement that shows prepaid fuel selected.

zoe: pasted photos 1026-06-14 18:05 return.jpg shows full tank gauge and odometer 48213. rental agreement line: "Fuel option: Prepaid Fuel - $60" and confirmation email from QuickCar. Charge on statement is $75 with merchant code QUICKCAR-FUEL.

mike-finance: thanks. two paths: 1) we open a merchant inquiry with QuickCar and card issuer to reverse the $75 if they charged incorrectly; 2) if reversal fails, manager can approve reimbursing net proven fuel cost (but not markup). do you have receipt for actual fuel if you paid later?

zoe: I did not pay for fuel later, since tank was full. Only photos. QuickCar support emailed "charge is non-refundable per local partner policy" but didn't provide evidence. I replied asking for itemized fuel invoice and odometer match.

expenses-bot: Checklist: Please upload rental agreement, return photos, confirmation emails, and the merchant statement line. Also capture any vendor replies. Merchant inquiries may take 7-21 business days. If vendor cannot justify charge, expense team will process a manager-approved reimbursement or dispute outcome.

harper: Harper (manager) here: I reviewed the docs, Zoe clearly selected prepaid fuel and returned car full. I approve provisional reimbursement up to $60 (the prepaid amount) if vendor doesn't reverse. Please mark as manager-approved for audit trail.

mike-finance: Noted. I'll open the merchant inquiry with the issuing bank and attach all uploads. If bank reverses the $75, we'll close the case and no reimbursement required. If reversal denied, we'll reimburse $60 to Zoe's personal card and tag the extra $15 as vendor markup which we won't cover.

zoe: thanks for moving quickly. Do you need anything else from me?

mike-finance: Just confirm the Ramp entry includes Harper's approval text: "Manager Harper approves provisional reimbursement up to $60 if vendor does not refund wrongful $75 fuel charge." Once that's there I'll set the case status to 'In Dispute'. Expect bank update in ~10 business days.

zoe: added manager approval note to Ramp and re-submitted. Thanks everyone.

expenses-bot: Case opened: merchant inquiry #QC-2026-334. Action items: bank follow-up and finance to reconcile once outcome known. Retain photos and emails for audit.
